function: Uplink channel estimation in a multiuser SIM-aided holographic MIMO system: a 1D-CNN maps received pilots to the channel from the last SIM layer to each user (p. 3).
system: BS with Nr=5 antennas, Nt=4 single-antenna users, stacked intelligent metasurface (SIM) with L=6 layers, 28 GHz carrier (p. 4).
method: Supervised 1D-CNN (three conv layers, two dense layers) trained offline with Adam on simulated pilot-channel pairs (p. 4).
data_channel: Custom simulator: complex Gaussian channel CN(0, beta_k R) with spatial correlation R following Demir et al. [8]; 80,000 samples, 80% for training (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Training and testing over SNR -5 to 25 dB, 80/20 split; sweeps of L, N, Nr at 10 dB, retraining not stated (p. 4-5).
baselines: Classical: LS, MMSE, RSLS [7]; learned: Dense, GRU and LSTM networks applied to the same estimation task (p. 4-5).
metrics: Mean squared error (MSE) in dB versus SNR, number of SIM layers, meta-atoms per layer, and BS antennas (p. 4-5).
complexity: Orders in Table II: 1D-CNN O(L*Nt*D), MMSE O((B*Nr)^3), LS O(N^3), RSLS O(alpha*B*Nr+alpha*N); no measured runtime or parameter count (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 2: "Following the methodology in [8], the elements of the correlation matrix R are determined through the double integral"; the channel is a custom simulator (Gaussian fading, path loss C0 d^-gamma on p. 4), with no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 4: "Both the training and testing are performed within the aforementioned SNR range"; the L, N and Nr sweeps of p. 5 are not stated as tests of a model trained on another configuration, and p. 5: "The training time scales linearly with the number of users" points to training per configuration.
q3_support: p. 4: "The proposed 1D-CNN outperforms the benchmark models Dense, GRU, LSTM on all SNR values"; p. 5: "the proposed 1D-CNN consistently outperforms all competing methods across the entire SNR range" (LS, MMSE, RSLS), all compared on MSE (Figs. 3 and 4(a)).
q4_support: p. 4: "The proposed 1D-CNN has fixed inference cost (O(LNtD))"; Table II on the same page lists the orders of complexity of the 1D-CNN, MMSE, LS and RSLS.
q5_support: p. 4: "data is generated of which 80% is used for training"; the data come from the authors' own simulator, and the paper gives no link, DOI, public dataset or measured data.
notes: Included: a deep-learning channel estimator for a stacked intelligent metasurface (a stacked RIS), so ris=1 and area 2; title and DOI 10.1109/LCOMM.2025.3607027 are on p. 1. The BS has 5 antennas, so the system check passes. The Dense, GRU and LSTM baselines are standard architectures applied to the same task. N is used only as a sweep in Fig. 4(c), and the paper never says whether the network is retrained for each L, N or Nr.
